name: Prolific Mindset
detailed_description:
Prolific Mindset is a relaxing life sim that empowers you to take control of your future. Master your finances, build powerful habits, and grow within a supportive, like-minded community. Set meaningful goals, track your progress, and create your own blueprint for success — all within a calm, focused, and beautifully immersive environment.

Core Features:

💸 Value Investing
Learn timeless investment strategies inspired by real-world principles. Simulate your portfolio, study market trends, and grow your financial knowledge at your own pace.

📚 Book Club
Explore life-changing books, take notes, and connect with others through in-game discussions that spark personal and financial growth.

🌐 Business Social Media App
Network with in-game characters, share insights, and build your brand in a positive digital space designed for collaboration and ambition.

📊 Budgeting App
Plan your expenses, track your income, and visualize your path to financial freedom with intuitive in-game budgeting tools.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for immersive audio experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • VR Support: Gamepad support enabled
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced with headphones and a focused mindset
